# case: compression ratio of dxc vs fxc shader objects, and per-container-part breakdown
# harness: measure.py (committed beside this file); re-run with `python measure.py`
# compiler: main-debug  C:\prj\DirectXShaderCompiler\build\Debug\bin\dxc.exe
# contrast: fxc.exe 10.0.26100.0 (Windows SDK), /T ps_5_1 -- fxc cannot emit SM6, and the
#           migration from fxc to dxc is exactly the comparison the reporter made
# ran: 2026-08-07T05:05:26Z
# verdict: unscored -- the symptom is a ratio; match.json's vocabulary is exit codes and text
# note: ratio = len(raw-deflate(bytes)) / len(bytes), level 9, wbits=-15 -- a .zip member
#       exactly, and a .zip compresses each member independently, which is the reporter's
#       "if I will zip same shaders"
